.deleteuser — erase an account permanently (owner)

  .deleteuser <name>   two gates, then it is gone

GONE: the account, their profile, their mailbox, and their private .revtell
lines. There is no undo. Two gates, in order: re-type the username exactly
(this is the one that catches "wrong person"), then your OWN password.
Either one failing cancels with nothing touched.

The name is freed for re-registration and they are disconnected if online.
NOT touched: mail they SENT (it is the recipients', not theirs), and any
ban on the name or IP — deletion is not a way around one. Logged as a fact.
